segments.text: Queſt. 124. Which is the third Petition?

Anſ.
"THY WILL BE DONE IN EARTH AS IT IS IN HEAVEN." That is, grant that we and all Men may renounce our own Will, & without murmuring obey Thy Will which is only good; that ſo every one may attend to and perform the Duties of his Station and Calling as willingly and faithfully, as the Angels do in Heaven.
